description: Department of Forest Conservation - State Lands named Madura Nagar and Nambankulam as Reserved Forests - Madura Nagar reserved Forest and Nambankulam reserved Forest are subjected to the single control of the Conservator General of Forests
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration of state lands (Madura Nagar and Nambankulam) as Reserved Forests under the Forest Conservation Ordinance. It includes detailed geographic coordinates and boundaries for the land parcels, which falls under land-related administrative matters. While it mentions a government official (State Minister Wimalaweera Dissanayake), the core content focuses on land designation and conservation rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
